originality.rationale: The 2022 conditioned-forward-time publication supplies a general density and explicitly the exponential-clock sufficient case, not the Poisson-only converse or all-horizon Gamma spatial ordering and first inverse-distance correction. Gamma hazard and abstract age/residual properties are separately known. The present physical-observation rigidity requires injectivity of the Brownian heat kernel and the complete Gamma phase classification requires an ordered posterior and a controlled saddle. The leading exponential far-field law is not claimed original. A broad abstract theorem might subsume the classification and remains a stated priority risk.
residual_risks: A broader unindexed conditional stochastic-order theorem with a total-positivity kernel could already yield the sign classification as a corollary.

value.rationale: Current displacement becomes an observable predictor of the next intervention time, with a sign reversal at the Poisson boundary for an entire natural Gamma family. The arbitrary-renewal independence converse gives a clock-identification criterion based on a joint spatial/next-event observation and the inverse-distance correction quantifies the forecast for far excursions. These are structurally motivated observables beyond another stationary moment or an arbitrary parameter slice.
